Communication is key in any relationship, and openly discussing your feelings can sometimes clarify or improve things.

If you feel like these steps don't resolve your dissatisfaction, it may be beneficial to think about your options within the framework of your marital status. For example, considering couples therapy separately from your husband can also provide insights and strategies without implying blame. Whatever you decide, remember that your well-being is important too.
